name: The Court of Life And Death
source:
The Court of Life And Death is a visual novel hybrid game, with multiple branching paths, to choose to examine the nature of life, a good life, justice, mercy. From the standpoint of a middle aged woman who died from a sudden heart attack, with much history, and with much to live for? Can she convince the judges to send her back? 

[From [url=https://endlessmidnight.itch.io/the-court-of-life-and-death]itch.io[/url]]
